meta.name: convert-documents-to-markdown
meta.description: Convert an attached Word document, presentation, spreadsheet, OpenDocument file, RTF, EPUB, CSV, or text-based PDF into local Markdown. Use when a message supplies a local attachment path that must be read without uploading it to an external parser.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常需要把办公文档转成Markdown格式
copy.tagline_en: Turn office documents into local Markdown
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need office documents as Markdown

howto.what: 你给出附件的本地路径后,Claude 会在容器内用 anydoc 把它转成 Markdown,打印输出文件路径,再按需要读取内容。支持 Word、演示文稿、表格、PDF 等。
howto.when: 当你的消息带有一个本地附件路径、需要读取它又不能上传到外部解析服务时,Claude 会接手转换。

say.text: 这是附件的本地路径,转成 Markdown 并告诉我输出文件在哪。
say.note: 转换在容器内本地完成。

say.text: 读取这个表格文件,只总结相关部分。
say.note: 按需读取,不整篇放进上下文。

say.text: 这个 PDF 没转成功,说明一下原因。
say.note: 会报出扫描件、加密等失败原因。

howto.what_en: Given a local attachment path, Claude converts it to Markdown inside the agent container with anydoc, prints the output path, then reads what is needed. Word, presentations, spreadsheets, PDF and more are listed as supported.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a message supplies a local attachment path that must be read without uploading it to an external parser.

say_en.text: Here is the attachment's local path; convert it to Markdown and tell me the output file.
say_en.note: Conversion runs locally in the container.

say_en.text: Read this spreadsheet file and summarize only the relevant parts.
This PDF failed to convert, explain why.
say_en.note: Reports scans, encryption and other failures.
